chrome/academic-paper.title: Academic paper
chrome/academic-paper.description: A two-column paper: full-width title and abstract, numbered sections, citations, a formula, a figure, footnotes, references.

chrome/code-listing.title: Code listing
chrome/code-listing.description: Monospaced code blocks with indentation, inline code, and prose around them.

chrome/form-fields.title: Printed form
chrome/form-fields.description: A printed application form: labels with fill-in lines, tick boxes, date boxes and a signature line.

chrome/headings-emphasis.title: Headings and text styles
chrome/headings-emphasis.description: Three heading levels, bold, italic, bold italic, underline, strike, colours, sizes, super/subscript, a block quote.

chrome/highlights-callouts.title: Highlights and callout boxes
chrome/highlights-callouts.description: Highlighted text, coloured callout boxes, white text on a dark box, a bordered quote.

chrome/images-figures.title: Images and figures
chrome/images-figures.description: A chart, a JPEG photo floated right with text wrapping round it, and a logo with transparency.

chrome/international.title: Many languages
chrome/international.description: Paragraphs in a dozen scripts, including right-to-left Arabic and Hebrew, CJK, Devanagari and Thai.

chrome/invoice.title: Invoice
chrome/invoice.description: An invoice: logo, address blocks, item table, totals, and a rotated PAID stamp over the totals.

chrome/letter-a4.title: Business letter
chrome/letter-a4.description: A business letter: sender block, date, recipient, bold subject line, signature.

chrome/lists.title: Lists
chrome/lists.description: Bulleted, numbered, nested (three levels), lettered and roman lists, and a checklist.

chrome/mixed-page-sizes.title: Mixed page sizes
chrome/mixed-page-sizes.description: Pages of different sizes in one file: A4 portrait, A4 landscape, A5.

chrome/multipage-report.title: Eight-page report
chrome/multipage-report.description: An eight-page report: title page, contents, sections on new pages, running header and page numbers.

chrome/prose-letter.title: Plain prose
chrome/prose-letter.description: Plain single-column prose in Georgia, US Letter, one heading.

chrome/rotated-labels.title: Rotated table headers
chrome/rotated-labels.description: A table with column headers rotated 90 degrees and a vertical margin label.

chrome/small-print.description: Dense 7 pt justified terms and conditions with numbered clauses over two pages.

chrome/table-borderless.title: Table without borders
chrome/table-borderless.description: A financial statement: no rules, indented labels, right-aligned figures, bold subtotals.

chrome/table-spans.title: Table with merged cells
chrome/table-spans.description: A table with column and row spans, a two-level header and cells whose text wraps.

chrome/three-column-newsletter.title: Three-column newsletter
chrome/three-column-newsletter.description: A newsletter: coloured masthead, three columns, an image inside a column, a pull quote.

chrome/two-column-article.title: Two-column article
chrome/two-column-article.description: A two-column article with a spanning title, justified hyphenated text and a drop cap.

chrome/watermark-draft.title: Memo with a watermark
chrome/watermark-draft.description: A memo with a large diagonal DRAFT watermark behind the text.

handmade/raw-base14.title: Standard PDF fonts
handmade/raw-base14.description: Base-14 fonts only (Helvetica, Times, Courier and their bold/italic), colours and sizes 8-24 pt.

handmade/raw-rotate90.title: Rotated page
handmade/raw-rotate90.description: A landscape MediaBox with /Rotate 90, shown portrait.

handmade/raw-text-grid.title: Timetable without lines
handmade/raw-text-grid.description: A timetable made of positioned text only: columns but no rules.

handmade/scanned-page.title: Scanned page
handmade/scanned-page.description: An image-only page with no text layer (a rendered page, like a scan).

mcp-suite/chrome-turkish.title: Turkish text

mcp-suite/content-array.title: Tricky text placement
mcp-suite/content-array.description: Text split across content streams, invisible text, clipping, word and character spacing.

mcp-suite/inherited.title: Inherited page settings

mcp-suite/lo-writer-turkish.title: Turkish document from LibreOffice
mcp-suite/lo-writer-turkish.description: A Turkish Writer document with headings and a table (LibreOffice).

mcp-suite/type3.title: Hand-drawn font glyphs
mcp-suite/type3.description: Text drawn with a Type 3 font.
